name: – Rasa Juknevičienė – After § 64 – Am 12
title: REPORT on Hybrid warfare and the protection of the EU’s territorial integrity and critical security and defence infrastructure
part_text: 64c. Condemns the activities of non-governmental organisations and other entities that knowingly facilitate, encourage or assist illegal immigration towards the external borders of Member States, particularly where such activities contribute to, support or are exploited as part of hybrid operations aimed at destabilising a Member State; considers it unacceptable that organisations engaging in such activities should benefit from public funding; calls on the Commission to immediately suspend EU funding to any organisation or entity found to have knowingly facilitated or participated in such activities, to recover funds already granted where legally possible and to ensure that such organisations are excluded from future EU funding;
